stories.title: Iran fires missiles at US bases in Jordan after American strikes near Hormuz
stories.reason: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it launched missiles and drones at two bases housing US forces and shot down a US drone, the sharpest exchange yet after a month-long lull in the six-month war.

stories.title: Oil tops $90 a barrel and stocks slide as US-Iran fighting flares again
stories.reason: Crude jumped more than 3% and the S&P 500 fell as traders priced in fresh inflation risk from the conflict, complicating the Fed's already-uncertain path on September rates.

stories.title: California lawmakers race to pass two dozen AI bills before adjourning for the year
stories.reason: Bills covering chatbot safety, kids' use of AI companions, and frontier-model oversight face a hard deadline tonight, after which Governor Newsom gets 30 days to sign or veto each one.

stories.title: Rescuers race to reach roughly 900 workers trapped in Nepal's flooded hydropower tunnels
stories.reason: Nine tunnels across two districts were buried in mud when last week's glacier-collapse flood hit, and industry officials say Nepal lacks the equipment to reach many of the missing on its own.

stories.title: China's DeepSeek nears $7.4 billion funding round at a $74 billion valuation ahead of 2027 IPO
stories.reason: The round, roughly doubling DeepSeek's valuation from June, funds a compute buildout as the low-cost model maker prepares for a Shanghai listing and intensifies price competition with US labs.

stories.title: AI chatbots beat search engines at debunking foreign propaganda, NPR/NewsGuard test finds
stories.reason: Tested against 30 false narratives pushed by China, Iran and Russia, chatbots debunked them more reliably than AI summaries on top of search results -- a notable data point as governments worry about AI-amplified disinformation.

stories.title: Nvidia forecasts 70% sales growth next year, far outpacing analyst estimates
stories.reason: The forecast, roughly $200 billion above the prior outlook, triggered Nvidia's biggest one-day rally since April 2025 even as the company warns memory shortages are capping how fast it can grow.

stories.title: Nepal criticized for hesitating to accept foreign rescue help after deadly floods
stories.reason: Delays in accepting outside specialists may have cost crucial time for hundreds still trapped, raising questions about disaster-response coordination as the death toll continues to climb.
